title: NPC: the keeper
purpose: The harbour keeper (docs/story/cast.md), painted once and skinned to a few bones in Godot. Stands by the lighthouse door in harbour_steps and talks by default.

fields.character: the old harbour keeper: tall and thin, in a long oilskin coat and a wide-brimmed hat, a coil of rope over one shoulder, an unlit storm lantern in one hand.
fields.face: the face is lost in the shadow of the hat brim; only a white beard edge catches the light
fields.pose: standing, slightly bent forward into the wind, the lantern hanging from the right hand away from the coat, the left hand on the rope.

must: The whole figure, hat to boots, with space around it
Arms and the lantern standing clear of the coat
mustNot: Ground, shadow, scenery or a painted background
criteria: Whole from hat to boots, nothing cropped
Arms and head clear enough of the body to bend with a few bones
Mid and light greys, so a black hero reads against it
